answer: The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, released only after three unrelated confirmations, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. By the orchard of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. A lagoon of per-task receipts records who did what, and the nectar of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
